ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota DHS Leadership Change
ideas.description: Investigate the sudden removal of Commissioner Shireen Gandhi amid fraud scrutiny and a day before a confirmation hearing.
questions: What led to the removal of Commissioner Gandhi?
What is the extent of the fraud and misuse of funds?
ideas.insight: The sudden removal of Commissioner Gandhi raises questions about potential fraud and misuse of funds. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the fraud and identify those responsible.

ideas.title: Daycare Centers Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the investigation into 9 daycare centers raided by federal agents and the $67 million sent to these centers.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud and misuse of funds?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: The large sum of money sent to these centers raises concerns about potential fraud and misuse of funds. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the fraud and identify those responsible.
